bridge.scope: VPS -> authenticated HTTPS broker -> contributor-controlled N4K48 agent -> local catalog -> result returned to Bridge

environment.description: MyZubster VPS bridge plus contributor-controlled Docker environment; outbound-only participant agent

steps: Create a bounded gallery job on the broker.
Allow the authenticated contributor agent to lease the job.
Return the bounded result to the broker.
Verify completed state during TTL and expected expiry afterwards.

observation.summary: The contributor-controlled agent returned the expected four-title gallery result and the broker recorded state done.

limitations: Does not establish direct P2P networking.
Does not establish security certification or penetration-test coverage.
Does not infer payment, employment, ownership or governance authority.
